protocol.entry_price: close_price captured with the raw event
protocol.exit_price: latest completed 1h candle close at or before the horizon; no future candle close
protocol.every_alert_policy: execute LONG entry for every eligible observation
protocol.current_filter_policy: execute only when strategy_action is LONG; otherwise zero return
protocol.normalized_filter_policy: execute only when normalized_action is LONG; WAIT or missing score abstains with zero return
protocol.short_semantics: SHORT is abstention, not a short trade
protocol.cost_application: only executed virtual trades; cash has zero cost
protocol.independence_note: deduplication removes repeated scanner observations; symbol/time overlap remains disclosed

stopping_rule.proposal: Collect through 2026-10-20T19:23:38Z, then allow 24 additional hours for the primary horizon.

commands: Use deduplicate_alert_events(events) with the recorded dedupe key.
